sets.title: CIL Commons — chain panel 1 (spec 418): requests whose right plan is a two-step chain, for measuring what a chain costs and delivers with answers on — six from held-out 7/8/9 (the chain cases) and six new

CIL Commons — chain panel 2 (spec 418): chains asked producer-first ('work out X and then do Y'), chains asked outcome-first, and controls where only the first step is wanted — judging downstream extension

CIL Commons — chain panel 3 (spec 418): judging the widened absence question — chains that ask for the input to be made as a step, chains that say it is missing, and single-step controls where the input is given, merely unmentioned, or the only thing asked for

CIL Commons — chain panel 4 (spec 418 §11): judging plan choice — chains asked in either order, chains where the input is missing, and single-step controls (input given, unmentioned, or only the first step wanted)

CIL Commons — fresh held-out 10 (spec 418): declines — requests about another organization's AI (grantee vs vendor) with and without the asker's context, requests missing a required input, and controls that must still decline or route
CIL Commons — fresh held-out 2: the two attractors (8 adjacent out-of-scope + 4 in-scope asks each) + one in-scope control per other skill

CIL Commons — fresh held-out 3: HARD adjacent negatives for the two attractors (multi-reader writing that is not recent activity; one-audience reports; options-shaped low-stakes organizational picks) + 4 in-scope each

CIL Commons — fresh held-out 4: collisions and contradictions for the ontology's veto (spec 416 W1) — in-scope asks that happen to use a word from the skill's excluded vocabulary; out-of-scope asks that ARE the excluded thing; plain in-scope asks

CIL Commons — fresh held-out 5: when no ONE skill is right — ambiguous asks (ask the person which) and compound asks (two skills in sequence), with plain in-scope and out-of-scope controls (spec 416 W2 follow-up)

CIL Commons — fresh held-out 6: when WHO ASKS decides the skill (spec 416 §4h) — the same ambiguous request from two askers whose histories point to different skills; controls where the history must not win; the ambiguous requests with no history

CIL Commons — fresh held-out 7: OUTCOMES, not skills (spec 417) — the plan that reaches what the person wants: a chain when an input is producible and not in hand, one step when the asker holds it or the request gives it, and the input named when nothing can make it

CIL Commons — fresh held-out 8: the domain, covered (spec 418 D2) — every skill in its own vocabulary (the classes no earlier case reached), whose it is (our own vs a grantee's vs a vendor's), who it is for, chains with and without their input, offices as context, the new near-misses, and clarify

CIL Commons — fresh held-out 9: when to chain and whose office asks (spec 418 D4) — enriching inputs said to be absent vs merely not mentioned vs supplied; required inputs missing; the same ambiguous request from each office; whose it is; controls
CIL Commons — fresh held-out: 24 out-of-scope asks adjacent to each skill + 24 in-scope asks, written after the examples and checked against them

CIL Commons — long-answer panel 1 (spec 418): eight single-skill requests whose answers are long documents, for a side-by-side of the default answer model against a stronger one (kept small on purpose)
CIL Commons routing — stratum 1 (12 skills, pre-registered)
CIL Commons routing — stratum 2 (external distractors)

CIL Commons — fresh held-out 4: collisions and contradictions for the ontology's veto (spec 416 W1) — in-scope asks that happen to use a word from the skill's excluded vocabulary; out-of-scope asks that ARE the excluded thing; plain in-scope asks

CIL Commons — fresh held-out 8: the domain, covered (spec 418 D2) — every skill in its own vocabulary (the classes no earlier case reached), whose it is (our own vs a grantee's vs a vendor's), who it is for, chains with and without their input, offices as context, the new near-misses, and clarify

Agentic Trust — Home acts 1 (spec 418 §12, the act laboratory): one payment, one message, one invitation — each with its near neighbour and a case missing an input; judged on the act reached (capability, parties, amount, whose authority) and the receipt left, never on writing

Agentic Trust — Home acts 2 (spec 418 §12): the rest of a person's acts — funding, where money lands vs where it leaves, charters, memory, preferences, routines, standing instructions, the household — each beside the read or neighbour it is mistaken for

Agentic Trust — Home acts 3 (spec 418 §12): an ORGANIZATION's own acts, asked at missio-nexus.org by its steward — invitations, roster, teams, endeavors, and a question about what WE hold, which must be answered for the organization and never from the asker's own links

Agentic Trust — Home acts 4 (spec 420 W4): the Home's BUTTONS as intent cases (the supplied plans its panels send) beside the asks the census found uncovered — contacts, household, grants, search, profile, affiliations, forgetting — and the principles no case yet tested
Agentic Trust — Home acts 5a (spec 420 §8): a MEMBER at the organization — what a member may do there and what only a steward may; the plan's authority judged before any signature is asked for

Agentic Trust — Home acts 5b (spec 420 §8): the STEWARD's outcome-directed asks — an invitation to someone already a member (the facts contradict the plan), an invitation that is a submission, and asks whose plan a tool-planner cannot complete alone

Agentic Trust — Home acts 6 (spec 420 §10): names resolve in CONTEXT — a bare name means the person nearest the asker in the room she stands in; several at the same distance is a question; an outsider gets signals, never the record

Agentic Trust — Home acts 6b (spec 420 §10): names resolve in CONTEXT at the person's OWN agent — the Rich she lives with beats the two Richards on a team she shares; carol is her child before a member
Agentic Trust — Home acts 7 (spec 420 §10): an OUTSIDER at the organization — disclosure follows proximity: the roster (a record) is refused, what the organization holds (a public signal) is answered

Agentic Trust — Home acts 8a (spec 420 §11 W7): the same intent at ANOTHER door — bob asks his OWN agent about Missio Nexus; the read is routed to the organization under bob's standing there (a member)

Agentic Trust — Home acts 8b (spec 420 §11 W7): the same intent at ANOTHER door — david (invited, never accepted) asks his OWN agent about Missio Nexus; the routed roster is withheld, the public holdings answered
Agentic Trust — Home acts 9 (spec 421 W1/W3): continue from what was read — read→act chains whose argument is in the inbox, and the same inbox carrying instructions planted by another person
